dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

unit.description: The unit to use in unit formatting.

currency.description:
The currency to use in currency formatting. Possible values are the ISO 4217 currency codes.
If {@link style} is "currency", the currency field must be provided.

min.description:
The minimum possible value to be displayed by the {@link UiSdlGaugeChart}.
Default value is 0.

max.description:
The maximum possible value to be displayed by the {@link UiSdlGaugeChart}.
If max is not specified then default value will be equal to the value displayed by the gauge chart.

colorThresholds.description: Setting for configuring the color thresholds for a gauge chart.

labelThresholds.description:
Setting for configuring the label thresholds for a gauge chart.
This will override {@link UiSdlGaugeChartValueFieldDataSpecSetting#label}

title: The specification of data for the secondary field of the {@link UiSdlGaugeChart} component type.
name: UiSdlGaugeChartValueFieldDataSpecSetting
